# Syntax parser

`acorn.js` is the unmodified `package/dist/acorn.js` from Acorn 8.18.0.
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/acorn/8.18.0 (official npm package metadata).
The package tarball SHA-512 was checked against its registry `dist.integrity` and the vendored file was byte-compared with the tarball.
License: MIT; see `ACORN-LICENSE`.

Rebuild the GitHub Pages runtime with `python3 scripts/build_resolver.py`.
No npm install, external CDN or execution of the source site's JS is required.
